name: Product Launch Video
summary: Turn a product URL, script or brief into a product marketing video built from time-coded shot sequences.
problem: Product launch videos need a clear feature story and visuals that develop across each shot rather than stopping after an opening animation.
coreOutcomes: Shape a product brief into a launch narrative
Plan and build time-coded visual shot sequences
requirements: A product or feature URL, script or marketing brief
A HyperFrames project and the required media resources
boundaries: Use for product marketing, launches and feature reveals
Do not use for generic topic explainers, non-product website tours, pull requests or short unnarrated motion graphics
